title: Wakeme Crypto
tagline: WakeMeCrypto: Ethereum DApp for rewarding wake-ups. Stake ETH, set alarms; wake up on time, reclaim stake. Failure results in stake loss. Smart contracts manage alarms, stakes, creating an incentivized wake-up system
description:
WakeMeCrypto is built on the blockchain that transforms waking up into a rewarding experience. Users can set alarms by staking Ethereum, and if they successfully wake up on time, they retrieve their staked amount. However, failure to wake up within a specified time results in losing the staked Ethereum. The DApp employs smart contracts to manage alarms and stakes, creating a unique and incentivized wake-up system.
If users successfully wake up and confirm their alert within the designated timeframe, they can retrieve their staked Ethereum along with the satisfaction of a punctual start to their day. However, failure to acknowledge the wake-up alert within the specified timeframe results in the loss of the staked amount. This mechanism introduces a novel incentive structure to encourage timely wake-ups and personal accountability.
how_its_made:
WakeMeCrypto combines ConnectKit for wallet management, Next.js for frontend development, a Solidity smart contract for stake and alarm management, wagmi/viem for blockchain integration, and the Web Notification API for user notifications.

The project's core functionality is governed by a Solidity smart contract on the Ethereum blockchain. This smart contract manages stakes and alarms, enforcing a gamified wake-up mechanism with transparent and automated execution.
